description: This file contains unit tests for the TrustStoreNSS class, which manages certificate trust settings using NSS (Network Security Services). It includes test classes, setup routines, and multiple test cases verifying trust and distrust handling, slot filtering, and trust settings for certificates in NSS databases.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSSTestBase
classes.description: Base class for NSS trust store tests, providing setup, utility functions, and common test logic for managing certificates and trust settings.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSSTestWithSlotFilterType
classes.description: Parameterized test class for verifying trust store behavior with different slot filter types and system trust settings.

classes.name: DebugData
classes.description: Helper class for storing user data during trust evaluation tests.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSSTestIgnoreSystemCerts
classes.description: Test class for verifying behavior when ignoring system trust settings.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSSTestWithoutSlotFilter
classes.description: Test class for trust store behavior without slot filtering.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSSTestDoNotAllowUserSlots
classes.description: Test class for verifying behavior when certificates on user slots are not trusted.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSSTestAllowSpecifiedUserSlot
classes.description: Test class for trusting certificates only on a specified user slot.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSSTestDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class for testing certificate issuer source functionality with NSS trust store.

methods.name: SystemTrustSettingToString
methods.description: Converts TrustStoreNSS system trust setting enum to string for debugging.

methods.name: TrustTypeToNSSTrust
methods.description: Maps CertificateTrustType enum to NSS trust flags.

methods.name: GetASSLTrustedBuiltinRoot
methods.description: Retrieves a trusted root certificate from NSS built-in roots.

methods.name: GetNSSTrustForCert
methods.description: Retrieves NSS trust flags for a given certificate.

methods.name: CreateTrustStoreNSS
methods.description: Factory method to create TrustStoreNSS instances with specific configurations.

methods.name: AddCertToNSSSlot
methods.description: Adds a certificate to an NSS slot.

methods.name: AddCertToNSSSlotWithTrust
methods.description: Adds a certificate to NSS slot and sets trust.

methods.name: AddCertsToNSS
methods.description: Adds multiple certificates to NSS slots for testing.

methods.name: ChangeCertTrust
methods.description: Changes trust settings for a certificate.

methods.name: ChangeCertTrustInSlot
methods.description: Changes trust for a certificate within a specific NSS slot.

methods.name: TrustStoreContains
methods.description: Checks if the trust store contains a certificate with expected trust.

methods.name: GetCertString
methods.description: Returns a string identifier for a certificate for debugging.

methods.name: HasTrust
methods.description: Verifies trust for a list of certificates matches expected trust.
